problem: Packet 003C-B waited for DaemonSet rollout but read DRA Pod and ResourceSlice state only once immediately afterward.
The proof refused before the workload, but its top-level handler emitted only the exception class and no stage or safe reason.
Immediate cleanup correctly removed the GPU node, making the transient failed assertion unrecoverable.

stable_dra_readiness: Poll for exactly one Running and Ready DRA Pod with the exact scanned digest.
Require gpu.nvidia.com and at least one matching gpu.nvidia.com ResourceSlice on the same GPU node with at least one device.
Require the same Pod UID, node and ResourceSlice fingerprint across three consecutive two-second reads.
Use a five-minute maximum and refuse without applying the ASR workload when stable readiness is absent.
diagnostic_receipt: Write a local no-PHI refusal receipt before returning failure to the cleanup trap.
Bind an explicit stage, exception type, safe reason and last DRA observation.
Never include DRA logs, audio, transcript text, credentials or patient data in the receipt.
budget: Treat the first attempt as a conservative 60 billable seconds even though termination was initiated after 43 observed seconds.
Limit a future retry to 7140 seconds so the conservative cumulative B6A GPU allowance does not exceed 7200 seconds.
Use the existing 15 USD reservation; create no second reservation.

allowed_local_operations: Add versioned 003C-C readiness proof deadline cleanup and window scripts
Add behavioral tests and dry-run simulations
Prepare local engineering evidence and a new 003C-C packet
Commit and push to the existing private branch

Any image rebuild scan substitution or waiver
Any claim that the 003C-B refusal was an ASR model or quality result
